reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Strengthening Malaria Control Service Delivery and Health System in Guinea - Guinea (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Guinea, Malaria, Catholic Relief Services - United States Conference of Catholic Bishops (CRS Guinea)This program has the following goals: D’ici la fin 2023, amener le pays vers la pré-élimination en réduisant la morbidité et la mortalité liées au paludisme de 50 % par rapport à 2016./ By the end of 2023, bring the country to pre-elimination by reducing malaria-related morbidity and mortality by 50% compared to 2016.. The objectives of this program are: Assurer la protection d’au moins 90 % de la population avec des mesures de préventions efficaces contre le paludisme. / Ensure the protection of at least 90% of the population with effective prevention measures against malaria. Assurer une prise en charge correcte et précoce d’au moins 90% des cas de paludisme./ Ensure correct and early management of at least 90% of malaria cases.. Renforcer les capacités de gestion, de partenariat, de coordination, de communication et de Suivi-Evaluation du Programme de lutte contre le paludisme à tous les niveaux./ Strengthen the management, partnership, coordination, communication and monitoring-evaluation capacities of the Malaria Control Program at all levels.. Offrir le paquet complet de santé communautaire incluant des services promotionnel, préventifs, curatifs et réadaptatifs de qualité dans 58% des communes rurales. /Offer the complete community health package including quality promotional, preventive, curative and rehabilitative services in 58% of rural communities. Améliorer la cohérence des données de 40% à 60% dans les établissements de santé. /Improve data consistency from 40% to 60% in healthcare establishments. Améliorer la disponibilité continue des médicaments traceurs dans les formations sanitaires de 89% à 95%. / Improve the continuous availability of tracer drugs in health facilities from 89% to 95%

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for GIN-M-CRSP04
Malaria parasite prevalence: Proportion of children aged 6-59 months with malaria infection
Outcome indicators targets and results for GIN-M-CRSP04
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people and/or sprayed by IRS within the last 12 months
Proportion of population that slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Percentage of antenatal clients with 1st visit before 12 weeks
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of pregnant women who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of population with access to an ITN within their household
Proportion of malaria cases (presumed and confirmed) that received first line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for GIN-M-CRSP04
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to targeted risk groups through continuous distribution
Proportion of pregnant women attending antenatal clinics who received three or more doses of intermittent preventive treatment for malaria
Proportion of community health workers who received at least one supportive supervision during the reporting period
Percentage of health facilities with tracer medicines for the three diseases available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to at-risk populations through mass campaigns
Percentage of children aged 3-59 months who received the full number of courses of SMC (3 or 4) per transmission season in the targeted areas
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment in the community
Completeness of facility reporting: Percentage of expected facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at private sector sites
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test in the community
Timeliness of facility reporting: Percentage of submitted facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
